meta.title: The Founding Partner program — Mobilcab
meta.description: The first 100 workshops who build Mobilcab with us get pricing locked for 12 months, a real say in what comes next, and access before everyone else.

hero.label: The Founding Partner program
hero.title: Help shape the tool Romanian workshops actually need.
hero.body: We're not looking for testers for unfinished software. We're looking for 100 workshops to build it with us — and in return they get locked-in pricing, a real say in what comes next, and access before everyone else.

counter.full: All {total} Founding Partner spots have been claimed.

items.title: Pricing locked for 12 months
items.body: You pay the same price for a whole year, however prices change after launch.

items.title: A say in what we build
items.body: Tell us what's missing in your workshop, and your ideas go straight into the roadmap.

items.title: Your name, as a Founding Partner
items.body: You're listed among the people who helped build Mobilcab.

items.title: Private feedback group
items.body: Talk directly with the founders and the other Founding Partners.

items.title: Access before everyone else
items.body: You get new features first, before they reach everyone.

offer.title: The offer
offer.detail: The Basic plan, with pricing locked for 12 months. Only for the first 100 workshops.
offer.noPayment: Nothing to pay now: you reserve your spot, and only pay once you get access.

ai.title: What Basic doesn't include
ai.body: Said plainly, so there are no surprises: Basic covers design, cutlists and CNC export. You try the AI assistant once, on the starter project, to see what it does. After that, AI is only included in the Starter (from 99 RON/month), Pro and Studio plans.
